msg: Hello! My partner and I are both Open Water certified, last dive in May. We'll be in Cartagena over the holidays and would love to dive on December 25th and on January 1st, from Cartagena. Is that possible and how much would it be?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.

msg: Oh, so neither of those dates works? Then could we do December 24th and January 2nd instead? How much is it for the two of us and how do we book? We're from Canada.
reply:
Yes, December 24 and January 2 are both operating days, so those dates work for planning, weather permitting. For certified divers departing from Cartagena, the options are:

You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; lodging isn’t included. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; lodging isn’t included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

I’m leaving the prices below. Since you’re both from Canada, the booking is in USD. You can book online using the link for the option you choose; the website applies the online discount automatically. The 2-dive option is here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en. The 3- and 4-dive packages don’t have online booking links, so I can connect you with a team advisor to arrange those. Which option would you like to book?

msg: We just want two separate day trips: 2 dives on December 24 and 2 dives on January 2, and we sleep in Cartagena both nights. Do we really need to stay overnight on the islands? What is the total for both of us?
reply:
No, you don’t need to stay overnight on the islands for two separate 2-dive day trips from Cartagena. Each trip returns to Cartagena the same day, so you can sleep there both nights.

For two people on both dates, I’m leaving the prices below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD

For the certified-diving trip, can you confirm you all have your certification (Open Water or higher)? You'll be asked for your cards on the day.

reply:

I’m leaving the prices below. Use this link for each date: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 392 USD · 436 USD
• 7 Dives - 3 days: 503 USD · 558 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.
